newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosmos rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosmos rated a buy.

text.p: MANILA, Nov 12 (REUTER) - Brokerage BPI Securities rated Cosmos Bottling Corporation a buy on Tuesday saying its acquisition of three bottling plants in the Visayas will widen its market base and boost earnings.

"Our initial estimates point towards a doubling of CBC's net earnings from the acquisition; however, there may be hidden costs to the merger which may surface only on integration of operations," Spencer Yap, BPI Securities research head said in a research paper.
Cosmos, the beverage unit of RFM Corp, announced over the weekend that it had acquired for 584 million pesos three cola bottling plants in central Visayas island.
Despite the "hidden costs," Yap said Cosmos gains immediate access to the growing markets in southern Philippines solidifying its position in the local softdrink market as a low-priced brand.
